newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo wheat harvest seen completed at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Yugo wheat harvest seen completed at weekend.

text.p: Yugoslavia's wheat harvest could be completed over coming weekend as some 95 percent of the total area of 812,000 hectares has already been harvested, a Yugoslav Chamber of Commerce official said on Thursday.

"We expect harvesting to finish this weekend as the crop remains to be collected from only some five percent of the wheat area," Milan Prostran, head of the Chamber's agriculture committee, told Reuters.
So far, the government expects an average yield of 3.8 tonnes per ha and a crop of some three million tonnes, Prostran said.

The government expectations are above the latest official statistics office's forecast based on the state of crop on June 20 which stood at 2.8 million tonnes with an average yield of 3.44 tonnes per ha.
Most of the wheat has already been stockpiled in silos as it had to be dried. --Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 311 4254
